column3: Close to the Greek; “cover His face” is rendered “blindfold Him.”
Close to the Greek; “the Nazarene” is rendered “of Nazareth.”
NKJV includes “and your speech shows it,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends with “you are a Galilean.”
Close to the Greek; “having broken down” (meaning uncertain) is rendered “when he thought about it.”
